rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something whose settings or position can be adjusted.

example.english: The armrests on this office chair are adjustable, so you can set them higher or lower.
example.traditional: 呢張電腦椅個扶手係可以調校嘅，你坐高坐低都得。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 din6 nou5 ji2 go3 fu4 sau2 hai6 ho2 ji5 tiu4 gaau3 ge3 nei5 co5 gou1 co5 dai1 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this concise form mainly in product descriptions or other semi-formal contexts.

example.english: The height of this desk lamp is adjustable, making it suitable for people of different heights.
example.traditional: 呢款枱燈高度可調校，適合唔同身高嘅人使用。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 ci4 dang1 gou1 dou6 ho2 tiu4 gaau3 sik1 hap6 m4 tung4 san1 gou1 ge3 jan4 sai2 jung6

rows.note: Use this especially for adjustable levels or settings such as brightness, temperature, or intensity.

example.english: The fan's speed is adjustable, so it will not be too strong at night.
example.traditional: 呢部風扇嘅風速可調節，夜晚開都唔怕太勁。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 fung1 sin3 ge3 fung1 cuk1 ho2 tiu4 zit3 je6 maan5 hoi1 dou1 m4 paa3 taai3 ging6
